latin: Quod scribit Tabet Chaldeus de dormitione super epar in reuelatione somniorum recte intelligetur si ad hoc dictum dicta Platonis in Timeo concordauerimus.
translation: What Thabit the Chaldean writes about sleeping upon the liver, in the revelation of dreams, will be rightly understood if we reconcile this saying with what Plato says in the Timaeus.
